info.name: Patty API
info.description:
Inventory and purchasing for a single-branch burger restaurant. Full contract: docs/api.md.

Run the **Scenario** folder top to bottom (Collection Runner, or `npx newman run docs/postman/patty.postman_collection.json -e docs/postman/local.postman_environment.json --folder Scenario`). It runs the brief end to end and asserts every number. The other folders hold one request per endpoint and reuse the ids the scenario saved.

Every write sends Content-Type: application/json, even with no body; the API answers 415 otherwise (S6).

item.name: Scenario
item.description: The brief end to end: ingredients, a recipe, a purchase order, refused moves, a partial delivery within the under-tolerance, over-delivery by percent and by cap, the closing delivery, a POS sale and its replay, then stock and history. Creates its own records with a unique suffix, so it can run on a seeded database.

header.description: Where the action came from, recorded in the audit trail (ui, pos or api).

request.description: 50,000 g of cheese is deliberate: 5% of it (2,500 g) is more than the 2,000 g cap, so step 11 can show the cap rejecting a delivery the percentage alone would allow (D-035).

exec: const lineOf = (order, ingredientId) => order.lines.find(l => l.ingredient.id === ingredientId);
pm.test('tolerances snapshotted: cheese may arrive at most 52,000 g (cap 2,000 g beats 5%)', () => pm.expect(lineOf(o, pm.collectionVariables.get('cheese_id')).max_receivable).to.eql(52000));
pm.test('beef completes from 950 g (5% under-tolerance)', () => pm.expect(lineOf(o, pm.collectionVariables.get('beef_id')).min_to_complete).to.eql(950));

exec: const by = id => d.deductions.find(x => x.ingredient.id === id);
pm.test('beef: 300 g out, 660 g left', () => { const x = by(pm.collectionVariables.get('beef_id')); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(300); pm.expect(x.on_hand_after).to.eql(660); });
pm.test('bun: 2 out, 8 left', () => { const x = by(pm.collectionVariables.get('bun_id')); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(x.on_hand_after).to.eql(8); });
pm.test('cheese: 40 g out, 49,960 g left', () => { const x = by(pm.collectionVariables.get('cheese_id')); pm.expect(x.quantity).to.eql(40); pm.expect(x.on_hand_after).to.eql(49960); });

item.description: Requests send X-Patty-Channel: pos, so the audit trail shows they came from the till.

header.description: Where the action came from, recorded in the audit trail (ui, pos or api).

Only checked when POS_API_KEY is set on the server (D-028). Leave pos_key empty otherwise.

request.description: As if the till were calling. Stock falls by the recipe. A sale is accepted even when it takes stock below zero: it already happened in the restaurant, and negative stock is flagged, not hidden (D-010). Resending the same pos_reference is a replay (200), with a different item or quantity it is 409 idempotency_conflict. Rate limited to 120 a minute.
